steps.name: Crystallized Salt (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] in 「Nidaros」, then enter the scenario dungeon 「Sandy Shore」 in 「Salar Coast」. Turn in the quest to [Carmen] inside.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Left foot forward. Right foot back.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Phew... I need a break. You have to pass next time, Carmen. You can't fail again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Who are you? I got permission to practice dancing here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not why I'm here. Embla sent me. She said I should talk to Carmen.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Embla did? Hmm, what could it be?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She told me to try a part-time job.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Oh, what a face to make when we've only just met. Give me a moment to compose myself. Ta-da!

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hehe, I'm Carmen.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ooooh! %s, I've heard so much about you. They say you're amazing!

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I was wondering who those rumors in Glaston were about. It was you, %s! Eee! That's so cool!

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I'll ask for your autograph later. Hehe, collecting famous people's autographs is my hobby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure, I'll sign one for you. But what kind of part-time job is this?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Do we... really have to do it right now?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I've tried all kinds of part-time jobs around town, but I always have to think twice about Embla's.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: It's the most bothersome and the hardest. The hourly pay is pretty good, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth does it involve...?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Nothing special. We collect salt crystals from the Salar Coast. They look a little pink by the sea, but if you look closely, they're red.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I'm not sure, but they're probably an ingredient for the drinks they make at Ash Tree.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: They aren't ordinary salt crystals. You have to pick ones that won't crumble easily, and they're hard to find.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Lately, these ghostlike monsters have appeared and started going after them. It's exhausting.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Sigh... It wasn't so bad when Askren helped me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go together. It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Really? Hehe, great. Then follow me! ♬

steps.name: Crystallized Salt (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] in 「Sandy Shore」, then use the Dig skill inside the dungeon to obtain a <Red Salt Crystal>. Go outside and turn in the quest to [Carmen] in [Nidaros].

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Whew, we're here.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: You can find salt crystals on the stretch of sand from here all the way over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't see any monsters right now.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: But the moment you set foot over there, bam! They'll start appearing like crazy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If monsters appear over there, isn't it dangerous here too?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I thought so too, so Askren and I checked last time. Strangely, they never come this far.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: It did feel like they were looking for something besides salt crystals, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Phew, let me catch my breath. I'm a little nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Carmen, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I had a hard time getting away last time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem really anxious... I'll go by myself. Wait here, Carmen.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Really? I'd be so grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is something Embla asked me to do. I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Then let me tell you how to get the salt crystals.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Use the [Dig] skill in front of the red lumps of salt that look like rocks.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: If you're lucky, you'll get a crystal right away. If you're unlucky, ghostlike monsters will appear and get in your way, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it's down to luck in the end. How many should I bring?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Exactly ten. Embla always tells me not to be greedy and to bring back only ten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Carmen. I'll be back as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Huh? Huh? Oh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Carmen, I'm finished.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Already? Woooow, you're incredible! I thought Askren was fast...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I'm speechless just watching you. Wow... And the salt crystals are in amazing condition!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Shall we head back to town?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought someone was there. It might just be my imagination...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Someone's here? But we're the only two people here right now... Don't tell me it's a ghost?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Th-There aren't any of those here.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Aaaah, %s! Now it really feels like there's a ghost!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't trying to scare you.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Aaah, I can't hear you! Th-There's no such thing as ghooosts!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, all right. Let's head back quickly, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something feels too strange to dismiss as my imagination. There is definitely something around the Salar Coast...)
(After Carmen and the adventurer leave, a silhouette-like hologram rises from the ground atop a distant cliff.)
「Search complete. Iteration 2049234.」
「Target object unconfirmed. Resetting coordinates...」
「Target energy detected on the Salar Coast. Location unconfirmed.」
「Resetting data for 'Wing' activation.」
「Target energy detected in the sea... underwater...」

steps.name: Crystallized Salt (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] and [Askren] in 「Nidaros」, then turn in the quest to [Askren] in 「Nidaros」.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hah, hah... It's been a while since I ran flat out. I'm out of breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one is chasing us, so you can relax.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Phewww. Okay, I'll relax. Thank you for your hard work, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It went well thanks to you, Carmen.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Oh, it was nothing. I'll take the salt crystals to Embla.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Carmen, I've been looking everywhere for you. Oh, %s, you're here too.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Why? What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You mustn't go to the coast.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: We already went.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Together with %s?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Yes. Embla asked us to get something.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You should have called me. We've always gone together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has Askren been keeping an eye on the beach all this time...?)

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I looked everywhere, but a certain priest was nowhere to be found. %s helped me, so I won't be going out again today anyway.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: All right, little one.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Who are you calling little? Look how tall I am!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm looking right at you.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Phew, I don't even have the energy to trade jokes with you, Askren. I'm going to see Embla. Then I have to practice again.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Thank you, %s. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you, Carmen.
(Carmen gathers up the salt crystals and heads toward Embla.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Askren. I said before that I would help if there was anything I could do, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is something on the beach, isn't there? You weren't going with Carmen simply to help her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was because something is there, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Would you follow me for a moment? There are too many eyes here.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: No crowds gathering to look at me here. I think I can speak now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please leave out the jokes.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, did that bother you? Then I'll get straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The reason I kept accompanying Carmen to the beach...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Was that I sensed the energy of ancient ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ancient ruins?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: As a priest of the Hodmis Order, my duty is to find ancient ruins, bring any artifacts we discover to the Order, and decipher them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So your work is rather like an archaeologist's.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: A little different. An archaeologist looks back at the past through artifacts and ruins. As a priest, I cover them up so they do not resurface.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: We seal away or destroy things the Order judges dangerous because they contain the power of the Twisted One or demons.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Within our capabilities, of course.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: An enormous amount of energy from ancient ruins is gathering on the Salar Coast. I cannot say exactly what kind, but it is extremely dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that sense of deja vu I felt...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I cannot be certain, but it was most likely caused by that energy.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The energy filling the coast feels strongly of the Twilight era, but the monsters appearing on the beach seem to be types from the time of the Chaotic Sky.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The Creed clan and the Silvaria Empire's knights who vanished back then...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Phew, that is all I have learned. Was it helpful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll need to investigate further, but this seems like an important lead.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What you just heard must remain strictly confidential. This information is entrusted only to you, %s, as a follower of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I am sure it will not happen, but if it were to leak outside...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Perhaps I should stop there. Voicing terrible imaginings is not to my taste. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The rest is a secret. A priest with secrets has a certain charm, don't you think? Hehe. I'll go see Embla now. Until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew... All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is happening here...?)
